say:1:1434202001:1.text: This was the first corrupted Essail I ever executed.
say:1:1434202001:1.source_cn: 这是我处刑的第一个孽化的艾塞勒。
say:1:1434202001:1.male: This was the first corrupted Essail I ever executed.
say:1:1434202001:1.female: This was the first corrupted Essail I ever executed.

say:2:1434202002:1.source_cn: 在处刑他之后，我无法停止追问自己……

say:3:1434202003:1.text: Did I kill a monster—or a man?
say:3:1434202003:1.source_cn: 我处刑的，究竟是人，还是野兽？
say:3:1434202003:1.male: Did I kill a monster—or a man?
say:3:1434202003:1.female: Did I kill a monster—or a man?

say:4:1434202004:1.text: He was once full of life. He didn't deserve the corruption.
say:4:1434202004:1.source_cn: 无可否认的是，他曾经是一个鲜活无比、本不必承受孽化命运...
say:4:1434202004:1.male: He was once full of life. He didn't deserve the corruption.
say:4:1434202004:1.female: He was once full of life. He didn't deserve the corruption.

say:5:1434202005:1.text: And yet, I was the one who ended that life.
say:5:1434202005:1.source_cn: 也是在我的手下，他的生命彻底走到了终点。
say:5:1434202005:1.male: And yet, I was the one who ended that life.
say:5:1434202005:1.female: And yet, I was the one who ended that life.

say:6:1434202006:1.text: That guilt... I'll carry it with me forever.
say:6:1434202006:1.source_cn: 这份罪孽感，我会一直背负着。
say:6:1434202006:1.male: That guilt... I'll carry it with me forever.
say:6:1434202006:1.female: That guilt... I'll carry it with me forever.
